fact: Minister Katambi said NIDA now serves 156 offices, with machines and equipment that print ID cards electronically.
NIDA, a government institution under the Ministry of Home Affairs, says it registers people, issues national IDs and maintains the national digital registry.
NIDA's deck names NIDA as the implementer for registration, ID issuance and data management, and lists in-house technical capacity among the supports of the system.
